caseName: Ruckelshaus v. Union Carbide Agricultural Products Co.
caseNameFull: Ruckelshaus, Administrator, United States Environmental Protection Agency v. Union Carbide Agricultural Products Co., Inc.

opinions.text: D. C. S. D. N. Y. Application for stay, presented to Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court is granted, and the District Court’s judgment in 79 Civ. 2913(RO) enjoining operation of § 3(c)(1)(D) [of the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act] is stayed pending disposition of the appeal.
